_comments: Documents that MJ: AI Models.APIName, DriverClass and DriverImportPath are flattened by vwAIModels
from the model's top-priority Active Inference Provider vendor row (#3066). They say nothing about
any other vendor serving the model, so vendor-specific code must read the MJ: AI Model Vendors row.
AutoUpdateDescription = 0 keeps CodeGen from replacing the text.

fields.Description: Read-only, from the view vwAIModels: the APIName of this model's highest-Priority Active Inference Provider row in MJ: AI Model Vendors. It describes that one vendor row only, not the model; another vendor that serves the same model can use a different value. Code that calls a specific vendor must read APIName from that vendor's MJ: AI Model Vendors row.
